about: This file lists the settings the launcher shows and the 'strata launch' flags each one turns into.
Do not edit this copy: an update replaces it. Put your changes in your own options.json instead
(the App tab has a button that opens it). In your file:
'settings': a list. An entry with a key that exists here replaces that setting; a new key adds one.
'remove': a list of keys to hide, for example ["speed", "tune"].
'address': the address the launcher asks for live figures. {port} is the value of the setting with the key 'port'.
choice: 'options' is a list of [value, text shown]. 'flags' is added with {value} replaced.
'flags_for' gives other flags for particular values. 'editable': true lets people type their own value.
number: 'min', 'max', 'step'. 'optional': true adds the choice "Strata's default".
switch: 'on' and 'off' are the flags for each state.
text:   free text; 'flags' is added with {value} replaced.
An empty value always adds nothing, so Strata uses its own default (or the preset's value).
Every flag is a normal 'strata launch' flag. Run: strata launch --help

settings.label: Context size
settings.help: How much text the model can hold at once. Bigger sizes take more graphics memory.

settings.label: Requests at the same time
settings.help: Each extra slot takes graphics memory. Strata's default fits the number to your card.

settings.label: Pictures
settings.help: Lets the model read pictures, if it can. GPU is faster and takes about 1 GB of graphics memory. CPU takes a few seconds per picture.

settings.label: Drafter
settings.help: A drafter guesses words ahead so answers come faster. Off saves about 1 GB of graphics memory.

settings.label: Conversation memory format
settings.help: How a conversation is kept on the card. q4_0 takes half the memory of int8.

settings.label: Graphics memory kept free (MiB)
settings.help: Raise it if the log warns that graphics memory is low.

settings.label: Speed or quality (DeepSeek models)
settings.help: Only DeepSeek models use this. Faster uses fewer parts of the model per word. Full uses all of them.

settings.label: Tuning before the start
settings.help: Strata can measure your computer to find the fastest settings. Quick takes about 20 minutes the first time. A stored result is used again.

settings.label: Cards to use
settings.help: Card numbers, for example 0 or 0,1. Leave empty and Strata chooses. The Setup tab lists the cards it found.

settings.label: A role for each card
settings.help: For two or more cards: main, helper or off for each, for example 0=main,1=helper. Leave empty and Strata chooses.

settings.label: Who can reach it
settings.help: This computer only is the safe choice. With a wider choice Strata makes an API key that other devices must send.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: The number at the end of the server's address.
